payload.title: Preserve literal Codex prompts and continuation values across CLI option parsing
payload.summary: P2: CodexAgent.send accepts arbitrary user text, but appends it to fresh/resumed CLI argv without an option terminator. Literal --help reaches installed codex-cli0.162.1 as a help option, exits0 with CLI help and raises CodexOutputError instead of transporting prompt text. Both actual maintained public send paths reproduced using help-only calls in authored temporary directories; no model/task invocation, dangerous flag or authority bypass was executed. Direct argv prevents shell splitting, not CLI option interpretation. Existing fake-executor tests miss this boundary. Baseline 87f5b9d2cbe8f92538af8510da7bca6e148d31b6. Acceptance: Independently protect leading-dash prompts, Unicode/multiline/empty controls and opaque continuation IDs from option parsing; explicitly handle the CLI dash/stdin sentinel. Prefer existing Command stdin mechanics or supported positional delimiting after inspecting current fresh/resume grammar, not a generic escaping framework. Preserve readonly/cwd/role/source/usage/error contracts and one invocation/no retry. Use deterministic executor/parser fakes and genuinely help-only CLI validation; do not rerun the baseline --help-through-adapter probe after correction where it might become a real model request.
payload.benefit: Restore the existing literal-input or metadata-only boundary without new Agent, execution, parsing or persistence architecture.
payload.uncertainty: Only deterministic authored input and version/help CLI execution. No live inference, dangerous option, production/private log or effect outside temporary test data; no demonstrated source-mutation or execution-authority bypass.
dependencies: Maintainer must separately authorize bounded implementation, permanent independent regressions and final committed protected gate; current audit authorizes documentation only.
